job: Open a website section with an eyebrow, a title, a lead line and its actions.
purpose: The one head every section type uses: an optional eyebrow (the eyebrow tokens, so data-headings moves it), a fluid title, a lead and up to two actions. Start-aligned by default; centred is a variant to use sparingly. split puts the title at the start and the lead and actions at the end on desktop.
useWhen: The top of any website section that needs a title.
A hero: put an fd-site-display title in it.

avoidWhen.when: A page title in the app.
The title of a docs article.

variants.useWhen: The default: everything on the start edge.
A launch band or a closing call to action; at most once or twice a page.
The default: title, lead and actions stacked.
A long title beside a short lead; or a title with a link to the full list at the end.

parts.role: The small label above the title; may hold an fd-site-index. One per three sections at most.
One primary and one quiet button.
